_comment: How a client shortens a long attachment / file name so its extension stays visible (2026-10-07): the name is split into head + tail + ext, and only head is truncated (「研究報告書_最終版_修正…2026年度.pdf」). ext: from the last '.' to the end, when that dot is not the first character (a dot file such as .env has no extension) nor the last, and the 1 to 8 characters after it hold no whitespace; otherwise there is no extension and the whole name is head (it truncates at the end as before). tail: with an extension and a stem (head + tail) longer than 12 code points, its last 6 code points, moved earlier so it never starts inside a character (a combining mark such as the NFD dakuten U+3099, a variation selector, a skin tone, ZWJ, a tag, Hangul vowel / final jamo, the second regional indicator of a flag, or the character after a ZWJ); otherwise empty. Lengths count Unicode code points. Hand-written; desktop (tests/fileNameEllipsis.test.ts), iOS (FileNameEllipsisTests) and Android (FileNameEllipsisTest) read this file.
